notes: Real prod shape: a single-clip 'subtitled' (Talking to camera) job with
speech cleanup, strict mode -- CLAUDE.md SILENCE_CUT_ENABLED /
strict_silence_cut is on and the computed CutPlan's bailout_reason is
anything other than None/clip_too_short/no_words -- i.e. the guard
refused to apply a cut plan it judged unsafe, per CLAUDE.md's
SILENCE_CUT_ENABLED note ('cleanup cut a word' is a guard bug, not this
lever; TestRuleZeroCannotCutRealSpeech pins the guard itself). The actual
bailout determination runs on a real Whisper transcript + ffmpeg silence
detection, which needs real audio bytes this repo never commits. What
contract itself -- constructing it with reason='unsafe_plan' and
confirming it carries a stable, typed .reason (never surfaced to the
worker's failure-reason mapping as a bare 'processing_failed') -- this is
the same typed-exception shape app.tasks.generative_build's real raise
site uses verbatim (grep-verified against this exact repo revision).
